findings.description: The configuration comment states this bucket is public, exposing the 'customer-master.xlsx' data it holds to unauthenticated access from the internet. No explicit acl/policy is shown in this file, so the public exposure rests on the stated configuration, but if public it constitutes an unrestricted-ingress access control failure.

The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so objects are stored unencrypted at rest. This bucket holds the customer-master data and is flagged as public, compounding the exposure of plaintext customer data.

The uploaded object 'customer-master.xlsx' has no server_side_encryption argument and the destination bucket (aws_s3_bucket.data) is unencrypted, so sensitive customer data is persisted in plaintext at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so financial data is stored unencrypted at rest despite the bucket name indicating sensitive financial records.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so operational data is stored unencrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so data science objects are stored unencrypted at rest.
